messages:
devon: quick favor — need short sudo to pull a small sample of logs for privacy redaction QA. will not store data.

claire_g: what's the exact query & justification? which dataset? duration?

devon: query against prod-logs. sample 500 lines around request-id pattern. justification: privacy team needs to validate our redaction regex after the recent log change. duration 15m. ticket: PRIV-4285

priya: ok pls confirm no raw PII will be exported. can you run within bastion and paste masked snippet only. also add a note in the ticket with post-run audit link.

devon: agreement — will run on bastion, only paste masked lines, no downloads. command I plan to run:
```
ssh bastion && sudo -u logreader psql -c "SELECT line FROM app_logs WHERE line LIKE '%request-id:%' AND ts >= '2026-03-16T10:00Z' AND ts < '2026-03-16T10:30Z' LIMIT 500;" > /tmp/sample.txt
```
I'll run `sed -E 's/([0-9]{3}-){2}[0-9]{4}/[SSN]/g'` locally to mask obvious stuff.

claire_g: I need the exact start/end time window too.

devon: window: 2026-03-16T10:00Z -> 2026-03-16T10:30Z (about 500 matches).

samir_oncall: granting 20m sudo to devon on host bastion-2. scope: read-only log query, no DB writes. I'll open break-glass ticket.

security-bot: ELEVATION_GRANTED user=devon approver=samir_oncall duration=20m resource=bastion-2 scope=read-only link=https://redwood.inc/infra/tickets/BRG-210

priya: added note in PRIV-4285 and left expected masked snippet format. please paste the masked example here after run so I can sign off. :white_check_mark:

devon: running now, will paste masked sample in thread when done. thx :pray:
